distribution.summary: China (CE, NO, SE, SW; broad source wording); Taiwan; Fujian; Jiangxi; Yunnan
distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports China (CE, NO, SE, SW) and Taiwan. Broad mainland regions are retained as source-scale evidence and are not converted into provinces. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Fujian, Jiangxi, Yunnan as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: General host context is retained at genus level. Pinus luchuensis is explicitly recorded in Taiwan and remains the only Taiwan-specific host identified in this source.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Orthotomicus angulatus (Eichhoff, 1876).
